title: Motus receipt v1
description: What a holder presents to a verifier: one commitment, the path proving it is in a sealed window, the checkpoint that sealed it, and — when they exist — the witness acknowledgement and the anchor that published the checkpoint. It travels alone, so it declares its own version. ADR-020 decision 4: the mode a receipt CLAIMS must be supported by what it carries, or the distinction between the three modes survives only in the engineers' heads.

mode.description: What this receipt claims. LOCAL: the commitment is in a chain. WITNESSED: an independent party acknowledged it before execution. QUALIFIED: witnessed plus identity and a qualified timestamp, neither of which this distribution produces.

proof.description: Siblings from leaf to root, each tagged with the side it sits on. An empty path is legal and means a single-leaf window.

anchor.description: Where the checkpoint was published, and whether that has finished. `state: pending` is an intention and proves nothing; only `anchored` with a reference supports EXISTENCE.

then.description: An anchor that says `anchored` and names no transaction has published nothing anybody can look up.
A receipt claiming WITNESSED without an acknowledgement is claiming the property that distinguishes it from LOCAL.
